Container.Name: hemlock-docker-pascal
Container.Overview: Two image-protection methods in one browser app. Hemlock is an independent, open-source take on the Nightshade method: it adds faint targeted changes so AI models that scrape the image learn the wrong thing (about 20 seconds per image on a fast card, minutes on an older one, with an ALT-text tag to post alongside). Mist v2 adds noise that disrupts copying an artist's style (slow, several minutes per image or much more on older cards). Pick a method, upload one image or a batch, compare before and after (hold, slider, or full resolution on desktop), and download the results or a zip. This is the build for older NVIDIA cards such as the GTX 10 series (Pascal, 8 GB): Hemlock should fit, Mist probably will not, and everything is slow. Do not use it on RTX 50 cards (install the Nvidia Driver plugin, driver 570 or newer, and keep --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters). Models are loaded only while needed and unloaded after the idle time below, so an idle container uses little RAM and no VRAM; the first job after that pays a short load time. Stable Diffusion 1.5 (about 5 GB) plus two small tagging models download into the data folder on first start. Uploaded images are deleted after the retention time below. There is no login unless you set a password, so keep it on your LAN or behind a reverse proxy. Deterrents, not guarantees, and not affiliated with the Nightshade or Mist teams.
Container.Requires: Install the Nvidia Driver plugin. No GPU? Remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters and it runs on the CPU, very slowly.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface. 7861 so it can run next to mist-docker on 7860.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Model cache (about 7 GB), Mist comparison images, optional concepts.txt / mapping.json, and temporary job files. If you used mist-docker you can point this at its appdata folder to reuse the Stable Diffusion download.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Unload models after idle (minutes)
Config.Description: After this many idle minutes the models are unloaded and VRAM and RAM are freed. 0 unloads after every job, -1 never unloads. Longer keeps jobs starting instantly, shorter frees the GPU for other containers sooner.

Config.Name: Delete uploads after (minutes)
Config.Description: How long uploaded and finished images stay on the server before they are removed (checked every few minutes).

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, visitors must enter this password (no username). Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Wrong-password lockout (tries)
Config.Description: Wrong passwords allowed from one address before it is locked out.

Config.Name: Lockout length (minutes)
Config.Description: How long an address stays locked out after too many wrong passwords.

Config.Name: Max images per run (Hemlock)
Config.Description: How many images one Hemlock run may contain. The download-all zip works for any batch size.

Config.Name: Max images per run (Mist)
Config.Description: How many images one Mist run may contain. Mist takes minutes per image, so lower this on shared servers.

Config.Name: Max image side for Mist (px)
Config.Description: Mist uploads larger than this on their longest side are shrunk before processing.

Config.Name: Queue length
Config.Description: How many runs may wait their turn before new ones are turned away.

Config.Name: Default Hemlock strength
Config.Description: What the form starts on: Light, Balanced or Strong. Use Light on a slow card.

Config.Name: Default Hemlock render quality
Config.Description: What the form starts on: Fast, Better, Thorough or Maximum. Use Fast on a slow card.

Config.Name: Default Mist strength
Config.Description: What the Mist form starts on: Light, Balanced or Strong.

Config.Name: Default Mist passes
Config.Description: What the Mist form starts on, 1 to 10.

Config.Name: Default method
Config.Description: hemlock or mist.

Config.Name: Speed factor for time estimates
Config.Description: Scales the starting time guesses shown to users. 1 is about an RTX 4070 SUPER, 1.5 about an RTX 5060 Ti, 4.5 about a GTX 1070. The server learns real times after a few runs.

Config.Name: Mist comparison images
Config.Description: Comparison images Mist generates on its first run and reuses afterwards. Upstream uses 50; fewer makes the first run quicker.

Config.Name: Automatic tag detection
Config.Description: 1 downloads two small models that name each image and pick a target concept for Hemlock. 0 skips them (type the tag yourself, targets are picked from the word list).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Leave as compute,utility.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask.
